# Instant Lead Hunt

Search X live for people matching the audience you describe.

Use for a one-off live search for people who match an audience. Not for an ongoing search (create-signal-agent), or a plain post search.

**The user might say:** "Search X live for people who match this audience and explain why each one fits: [describe the people you want]"

## Steps

1. Search live X for posts by people in the audience.
   ```sh
   xholic x search --query "<what they would post>" --sort Latest
   ```
2. Check the promising authors.
   ```sh
   xholic people get --username <handle>
   ```
3. Explain why each fits. For an ongoing search, use the create-signal-agent recipe.
